quotes.text: EWS doesn't use the same names as IMAP

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Exchange special-folder names can differ from IMAP names and can be localized by the organization. During account creation, do not classify EWS notable folders by name; use the EWS flags and folder identity path instead.
title: Find EWS special folders by server flags, not display names
